InvoiceDocumentCard. Pure display component. All data from previewModel (built by buildInvoicePreviewModel). Fields shown: logo, company name, tagline, address lines, status pill, invoice title, meta chips (number, dates, PO), client info, detail rows (payment terms, custom terms), line items (number, name, sub-description, facts/pills, image thumbnail, amount), totals (summary rows, grand total, amount in words), signatory (image, name, role). No editable fields — this is a read-only document preview.

PaymentHistoryCard. Collapsible (default: open). Shows: settled total, balance due, payment progress bar, payment rows. Each row: method, date+time, reference, notes, attachments (image/file icons), amount, receipt link (if receipt exists), void button (if not voided). "Record" button opens RecordPaymentSheet. Void button opens VoidPaymentDialog. Receipt link navigates to /receipts/{id}. Data: payments[], viewModel (cashReceived, balanceDue, invoiceTotal), receiptsByPayment (fetched from receipts table).

AdvanceInvoicesCard. Conditional Two states: (1) No advance: shows "CREATE" button. (2) Has advance: shows advance invoice number, date, total with "VIEW/EDIT" button. CREATE opens InvoiceAdvanceSheet. VIEW/EDIT calls onViewAdvance → navigates to advance details.

💰 Record Payment
InvoiceRecordPaymentSheet. Full payment recording form. Fields: cashReceived (NumericInput), percentage (text input with quick-pct buttons: 25/50/75/100), date (date input), method (Select: Transfer/Cash/POS/Cheque/Other), reference (text), bankAccountId (Select, conditional: only when method="Transfer"), notes (textarea), attachments (PaymentAttachmentUploader). Settlement preview: computed from getPaymentEntrySummary. Validation: validatePaymentEntry. Save: recordInvoicePayment → refresh + close. Conditional WHT note shown when invoice.wht > 0.

InvoiceMoreSheet. 4 sections, 11 actions total. Lifecycle: Revert to Quotation (opens confirm dialog), Generate Waybill (navigates to /waybills/new with prefill). Payments: Record Payment (opens sheet), Advance Invoice (opens sheet). Common: Link to Project (opens ProjectLinkDialog), Duplicate, Copy Number, Export CSV, Qty+Unit merge (toggle). Danger: Archive (opens confirm dialog), Delete (opens confirm dialog with destructive styling).

Confirmation Dialogs

Revert to Quotation: "INV-XXX will be converted back to an open quotation. Existing payment records will be deleted and cannot be recovered." → handleRevertToQuotation.
Archive: "INV-XXX will be moved to your archive." → handleArchive.
Delete: "INV-XXX will be permanently deleted." (destructive) → handleDelete.
Void Payment: Opens VoidPaymentDialog with reason input → confirmVoidPayment(reason).
Project Link: ProjectLinkDialog for associating invoice with a project.
